caption: Barga Duomo, Barga
composition: Romanesque collegiate church above the Garfagnana hilltown · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Barga Duomo across its stone terrace, the Romanesque church standing center-right with its round rose window and arcaded facade, its bell tower rising at the right edge. Terracotta rooftops of the hilltown cluster below to the left, and the blue-grey Apuan mountains fill the horizon behind. Bright 08:26 sunshine under a clear sky sharpens every arch and blind arcade on the pale stone.
